entities.summary: Holtreman is a spelling version of the Oultreman family name. The Holtreman name was adopted in Portugal by an Oultreman's family branch originally from Valenciennes. In the early 17th century, a knight called Jean (John) Houltremant served the Count of Vila Real in the reign of Philip III of Portugal. Jean Houltremant descended from an old lineage from the County of Flanders and the County of Hainaut being a grandson of Jacques d’Oultreman dit Houltreman, adviser of his majesty at Namur. Jean married Ana Antónia Nunes, daughter of Manuel Nunes and wife Ana Nunes, landowners of the Anadia region in Portugal.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The marriage of Jean Houltremant and Ana Antónia Nunes led to the consolidation of the Oultreman family's influence in Portugal, while his descent from an old lineage connected him to significant historical events in Flanders and Hainaut.
